user.title: Choose the cover
user.description: Choose the real cover to wrap (for example an Overkiz shutter). The new cover is placed under the same device and adds an estimated position.

data_description.source_entity: The cover entity that receives the commands.

parametres.title: Cover settings
parametres.description: Real cover: {source}. Time a complete trip of the cover, fully closed to fully open and back.

data.name: Cover name
data.take_over: Take over the name and identifier of the original cover

data_description.name: The name shown in Home Assistant. Keep the name of the original cover to take over its identifier (see below).
data_description.travel_time_up: Seconds needed for a complete opening (0 to 100 %).
data_description.travel_time_down: Seconds needed for a complete closing (100 to 0 %).
data_description.send_stop_at_ends: After a complete opening or closing, still send a stop command. Only useful if the cover does not stop by itself at the end of its travel. When in doubt, leave it off.
data_description.device_class: The type of equipment (shutter, blind, door...). It determines the icon.
data_description.hide_source: The original cover no longer appears in the automatic screens of Home Assistant. It is still used internally to send commands, and shown again if this cover is removed.
data_description.take_over: On: the new cover takes the name and identifier of the original cover (for example cover.kitchen_shutter) and the original is renamed with the suffix below. Your scripts and automations then use the new cover without any change. Off: the new cover gets a different identifier (for example cover.kitchen_shutter_2) and your scripts must be edited to use it. The swap only happens if the name above is the name of the original cover.
data_description.source_suffix: Added to the name and identifier of the original cover when it is renamed (for example "source" gives "Kitchen Shutter (source)" and cover.kitchen_shutter_source). No effect if the option above is off.

error.source_deja_chronometree: This cover already has an estimated position: choose the real cover.
error.suffixe_invalide: Enter a suffix made of letters or digits.

init.title: Cover settings
init.description: Changes apply immediately. The current position is kept. The name and the swap of names can only be set when the cover is created.

data_description.travel_time_up: Seconds needed for a complete opening (0 to 100 %).

data_description.send_stop_at_ends: After a complete opening or closing, still send a stop command. Only useful if the cover does not stop by itself at the end of its travel. When in doubt, leave it off.
data_description.device_class: The type of equipment (shutter, blind, door...). It determines the icon.
data_description.hide_source: The original cover no longer appears in the automatic screens of Home Assistant. It is still used internally to send commands, and shown again if this cover is removed.

set_known_position.name: Set known position
set_known_position.description: Tell the real position of the cover without moving it. Useful when the estimated position has drifted (for example after using the remote control).
